findings.claim: The how-to's first prerequisite points to call-openviking-from-the-cli.md for installing ov and ovx and creating the ovx profile localstack, but that page covers neither. It uses vault and curl only. The VAULT_ADDR bullet has no link at all, though the how-to skeleton rule says each prerequisite links to where to get it.

verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.
The Dockerfile installs ov-sync from the ov-sync-v0.3.0 tag.
devcontainer.json bind-mounts the host's ~/.openviking directory read-only, and the ~/.ovx mount is unchanged and still writable.
The new how-to and ADR 0024 match the plan and the tools' real behavior.
One docs finding that does not block: a prerequisite links to a page that does not give the reader what the bullet promises.
Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree came back green (2b28115609be50aa478b3f6caa4233d8bcd40b0a159d05f167fd54f475c022cd).
It passed pre_commit, cli_tests and eval rows r1 to r4.
r1: the test asserts the exact `RUN uv tool install ov-sync --from ...@ov-sync-v0.3.0#subdirectory=packages/ov-sync"` line.
It fails with a branch, another tag or no ref.
r2: exact membership of the full mount string, with type=bind and readonly.
It fails if the mount targets ovcli.conf or drops readonly.
r3: exact membership of the ~/.ovx mount string.
Adding `,readonly` or removing the mount makes it fail.
r4: the grep chain matches the new page, and test_how_to_skeleton passes.
The page has the four sections in order and Step 1 to Step 5.
r5: a judgment row deferred until the operator rebuilds, as the briefing says.
Not judged in this round.
CLI claims, checked against the spike ovsync v0.3.0 install and the image's ovx: `ovsync init <folder>` and `ovsync run <folder> --create-root` exist.
init writes ov-sync.toml and asks for root_uri under [sync].
`ovx -L --bind` and `--no-bind` exist.
ovx writes through a temp file and `os.replace`, so mounting the directory rather than the file is right.
Plain `ovx -L` re-binds when bound.json exists (`_offer_to_bind`), which matches the warning in Step 5.
ovx needs `$VAULT_ADDR`.
Consistency: no existing docs page covers the devcontainer's host mounts, so a new how-to fits plan step 3.
The index entries in docs/README.md and docs/how-to/README.md are right.
`kmctl check` passes.
The summary was re-acked against ADR 0024 with its body unchanged.
The ADR names the alternatives it rejected.
Slop scan of the new how-to and ADR: no em dashes, no ` -- ` in prose, no semicolon splices, no prose lines over 80 characters, no tier-1 words.

f1 (docs, not blocking): Prerequisites says "`ov` and `ovx` installed on the host, with an ovx profile `localstack`. See How to call OpenViking from the CLI." That page installs neither tool and never mentions ovx profiles.
It mints a token with `vault read` and calls the API with curl.
The `VAULT_ADDR` bullet has no link.
Point both bullets at a page that covers them, such as the ovx README in openviking_extensions at the pinned tag.
If no page covers them, drop the "See" so the bullet does not promise something the link does not give.
Step 3 says "The build fails" when ~/.openviking is missing.
Strictly, container creation fails on the bind source, not the image build.
A reader running Rebuild Container sees the same failure either way, so I am not raising it as a finding.
